control_flags.objectives: The lettered points of the paragraph. In paragraphs that list alternatives (the lawful bases of Article 6(1), the exceptions of Article 9(2), the derogations of Article 49(1)) the points are options, of which the applicable ones are assessed and the rest marked not applicable.
control_flags.paragraphs_in_text: On each article: how many paragraphs the revised text prints for it. The ones not built are powers to make regulations, functions of the Information Commission, or interpretive provisions.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable obligations that are implemented. The UK GDPR defines no score; this percentage is an HCG measure of progress.

rules.summary: An obligation is met only when every applicable element it lists is met.

rules.summary: A personal data breach is notified to the Information Commission without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of the controller becoming aware of it, unless it is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals.
rules.quote: not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it

glossary.definition: The General Data Protection Regulation as retained in United Kingdom law after EU exit and amended since, including by the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025.
The organisation that decides why and how personal data are processed.
An organisation that processes personal data on behalf of a controller.
The identified or identifiable person the personal data relate to.
The Information Commission, the United Kingdom's data protection regulator (formerly the Information Commissioner). In the UK GDPR "the Commission" means this body, not the European Commission.
Data protection impact assessment: an assessment of the effect of planned processing on the protection of personal data, required where the processing is likely to result in a high risk.
Data protection officer: the person designated to advise on and monitor compliance with the Regulation.
A lawful basis in Article 6(1)(ea) for processing that is necessary for one of the purposes listed in Annex 1, such as safeguarding national security or responding to an emergency.
